description:
crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/bipedal3.rs:119 and :288 cite 'Algorithm 2' of [Scheinerman2024] for the bipedal add/sub formulas. The paper carries no object labelled Algorithm 2; Theorem 2.1 is where the add, subtract, multiply, and divide formulas are stated. The same miscitation was corrected in crates/gf2-algebra (packed/bipedal3.rs, permanent/bipedal3_multiword.rs) under JIT issue 63d931a9 at commit 65dae3bf; these two comment sites are the remaining occurrences.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every citation of the bipedal operation formulas in crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/bipedal3.rs names [Scheinerman2024] Theorem 2.1, and a repository-wide search finds no remaining 'Algorithm 2' citation of [Scheinerman2024].
title: SIMD bipedal3 comments cite Scheinerman Algorithm 2, an object the paper does not carry
